scope: Three researched ranged weapons, real powered machining and cloth sandbags, 3D aiming/projectiles and armor/injuries, authentic v17 migration. Independent unit scenes, ordinary commands, source formulas and native runtime observations remain separate.

migrates authentic published v17 combat without changing prior physical progress

charges the 350 W machining load while idle, disconnects without free energy and joins only wired floors

matches independently extracted Core declarations and projectile defaults

clamps each quality-adjusted range stat before interpolating the 3/12/25/40 cell anchors

includes both sides of diagonal wall corners rather than slipping between voxels
visits all eight cubes at a 3D vertex so diagonal rays cannot skip a floor corner
includes both sides of coplanar segments and all closed-cell contacts at degenerate vertices
is reversible, unique and bounded for long corner rays and arbitrary fractional endpoints

excludes shooter-cell cover only from combined cover, retaining source cover-selection consumption
does not replace aim, cover and far prone checks with one final hit-chance roll
selects a physical cover before aiming and only then tests cover passage
produces bounded reproducible wild destinations and the source 50% non-target-pawn flag

keeps native five-to-twelve-cell interception gating, prone reduction and friendly-fire policy separate
rejects malformed map, cover and accuracy factors before calling geometry callbacks
retains weapon quality, shooting skill, cover and prone factors
keeps automatic doors opaque during their first 13 opening ticks and after closing
preserves cross-floor height filtering and physical floor blockage in the preview
interpolates all three flight coordinates and clamps without mutating saved flight state

campaign.scope: Fresh v18 colony. Only normal commands, step and save/load mutate simulation. Read-only terrain/path inspection selects sites. No injected resources, research, skills, positions, weapons, injuries, time or enemies. This single campaign is not a probability experiment.

failedAttempts.scope: An early generator candidate overlapped a real ladder. Site selection now rejects occupied footprint cells; gameplay placement restrictions were retained.

80 rice plots did not sustain the long research campaign. Expanding after malnutrition was too late. The final run starts fresh with 160 rice plots and does not inject food, health, skills or research.

Native machine-pistol runtime and Pawn tick order corrected nominal [0,7,14] to actual pawn warmup scheduling [0,6,13], mapped to [0,2,5] at 20 TPS. The complete frozen campaign executes the corrected source.
Legacy migration uses committed v17 fixture bytes and provenance instead of a test-results path overwritten by current regressions.

limitations: 20 TPS, 12000-tick days, integer movement and 3D supercover terrain are project adaptations. No native float-bit or random-stream replay.
Native checkedCells clears per movement sampling call; project interception visits each ray cell once over its flight. Hard 3D terrain blocks all launch branches.
Unit scenes explicitly arrange geometry, equipment and health. The separate fresh campaign uses only normal commands, step and save/load; one raid sequence is not a hit-probability experiment.
Six earlier affected-subsystem campaigns passed before the final sandbag stopping and burst-timing fixes; the final full unit suite and fresh ranged campaign cover the corrected code.
Only trees and cloth sandbags provide probabilistic cover. No lean shooting sources, gun ammunition inventory, terrain/door bullet durability, explosives, fire, weather events or full storyteller.
Native four-projectile sample includes developer-spawned equipment/target and mental-state cleanup; it is separate from Web ordinary production evidence.

Browser controls are real DOM/canvas actions with read-only snapshot/projection inspection, not screen-only perception. Six lifecycle cycles measure renderer resources and main page heap, excluding Worker/native/GPU memory; no universal memory capacity or long-duration leak proof.
